owners.attributionRationale: The March 31, 2026 SEC investment schedule for Partners Group Next Generation Infrastructure, LLC identifies Exus US Holdings, LP as a direct-equity investment acquired October 3, 2023. Name that one disclosed participating fund instead of treating the holding partnership as a fund; the remaining Partners Group client allocations are not publicly disclosed. Preserve the legal vehicle, unknown stake, 2023 entry and null curated fund link.

Partners Group's October 4, 2023 transaction announcement expressly invests alongside Exus founders and management. Their retained equity is a direct ownership interest, not an unresolved investment fund. Preserve the existing retained/rolled vehicle, unknown stake and original entry year; do not infer a minority percentage or manager fund.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Exus Renewables North America is a U.S.-based independent power producer, developer and operator that acquires, develops, repowers, builds, owns and manages utility-scale wind, solar and battery-storage assets. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, the platform also maintains U.S. offices in New York, Albuquerque and Connecticut and reports more than 6 GW of total capacity, including more than 700 MW operating or under construction. Partners Group invested on October 3, 2023 through Exus US Holdings, LP alongside retained founders and management, committing growth capital to build a standalone North American platform. The global Exus brand, investment holdcos, individual projects, bolt-ons and third-party mandates are not separate PortCos. No later platform sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
